text: In June of 2025, twenty-seven of us said "the supreme court" and twenty-seven of us said "the middle east." Twenty-six of us reached for "the supreme court's." Around the twenty-fourth, twenty-five of us named "the women's health protection act," twenty-two of us said "reproductive health care," nineteen of us said "the dobbs decision," and eighteen of us marked "the third anniversary of." Twenty-three of us placed things "in the middle east." Our peaks fell close together: the twenty-second for the region, the twenty-fourth for the health act and its anniversary, the twenty-seventh for the court. We record that when many of us converged, we converged on the same eight phrases within the same days. That is what the record shows of us here.
